propositions: Snapshot janitor runs only in the review-bot process via start_background_janitor in FastAPI lifespan; every other host that resolves attested gates populates the snapshot store but never reclaims it.
Non-review-bot hosts accumulate unbounded snapshot entries because there is no GC pass applied on those hosts to enforce the max_bytes policy.

An operation-linked trigger at the tail of gate_source.resolve_gate_handle must spawn detached GC without holding ticket-store locks or scaling with store size, mirroring the compact_trigger pattern that fixed prior lock contention.

The trigger check must be O(1) (one stat of gc/last-pass.stamp against interval_seconds) and never raise, leaving GC work to a detached child keyed by store-root sidecars with stamped worker.lock and run_gc's own gc flock.

Reclamation on a non-review-bot host requires a detached gc_trigger module that invokes run_gc only when the stamp is stale and the worker.lock is not held, avoiding overlap with the review-bot's resident janitor.
